Angular model diagnostics

Source: vignettes/model-diagnostics.Rmd
model-diagnostics.Rmd

Optional model integration

ggcircular keeps angular model packages optional. When CircularRegression is installed, model objects can be tidied, augmented and visualized with diagnostic plots.

library(ggplot2)
#> Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.5.2
library(ggcircular)
if (requireNamespace("CircularRegression", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit <- CircularRegression::consensus(direction ~ speed, data = wind_directions)

  tidy_circular(fit)
  glance_circular(fit)
}
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   model_class  nobs  npar logLik   AIC   BIC  kappa
#>   <chr>       <int> <int>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 consensus     500     1  0.145  1.71  5.93 0.0340

Circular residuals 

if (requireNamespace("CircularRegression", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit <- CircularRegression::consensus(direction ~ speed, data = wind_directions)
  residuals <- circular_residuals(fit)

  head(residuals)
  circular_model_diagnostics(fit)
}
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   model_class     n residual_mean residual_Rbar residual_variance
#>   <chr>       <int>         <dbl>         <dbl>             <dbl>
#> 1 consensus     500          1.08        0.0361             0.964
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: max_abs_residual <dbl>

Residual graphics 

if (requireNamespace("CircularRegression", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit <- CircularRegression::consensus(direction ~ speed, data = wind_directions)

  autoplot(fit, type = "residuals_rose")
  autoplot(fit, type = "residuals_density")
}

Mixtures of von Mises distributions 

fit_mix <- fit_vonmises_mixture(wind_directions$direction, k = 2)

tidy_circular(fit_mix)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   component proportion    mu kappa
#>       <int>      <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1         1      0.317 0.904 1.51 
#> 2         2      0.683 4.06  0.749
glance_circular(fit_mix)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>       n components logLik   AIC   BIC iterations converged axial
#>   <int>      <int>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>      <int> <lgl>     <lgl>
#> 1   500          2  -912. 1833. 1854.        200 FALSE     FALSE
ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction)) +
  geom_rose(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 24, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_vonmises_mixture(fit = fit_mix, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_circular_degrees() +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_circular()
